mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.25% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this dual signal remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500,000 in a month indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 2.5% YoY while FEDFUNDS is above 2% signals inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: UNRATE below the 12-month moving average predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to labor market resilience.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when UNRATE is below its 12-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% YoY signals housing market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this signal in mid-cycle expansions remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
